intro: Owning a home in Halkidiki is easy while you are here. When you are away for most of the year, someone local has to look after it. Our property management in Halkidiki does that for you: tenants and rent, bills and taxes, maintenance, repairs and regular inspections, all from one team that knows the area.
body:
What our property management includes

You choose what we take over. The full service covers:

  • Tenants: marketing of the property, showings, tenant screening and the lease agreement.
  • Money: rent collection, and the bills and taxes of the property paid on your behalf.
  • Upkeep: maintenance and repairs, carried out when they are needed.
  • Inspections: regular visits to check the state of the property.

Who it is for

Property management suits three kinds of owners in Halkidiki:

  • Owners who live abroad: the house stays closed for months and needs someone to check it, pay its bills and deal with problems.
  • Owners who rent out: a long-term tenant brings an income, but also questions, repairs and rent to collect.
  • New buyers: you have just bought through us and want the home ready, maintained and, if you wish, rented from the first season.

The service is the same team that helped you buy, so the property, its papers and its history are already known to us.

Tenants and rent collection

We advertise the property, show it to interested tenants and check them before anything is signed. We prepare the lease agreement with you and stay the tenants' contact for everyday questions, so they do not call you abroad. The rent is collected on your behalf. When a tenant leaves, we check the property, arrange what needs fixing and look for the next tenant, so that the home does not stay empty longer than needed.

Bills and taxes paid on time

A property in Greece comes with regular payments: electricity, water, the municipal charges and the annual property tax. We pay them for you, so nothing is missed while you are away. Late payments in Greece bring surcharges, and an unpaid bill can mean a supply is cut off just before you arrive; a local contact who pays on time avoids both.

Maintenance, repairs and inspections

We visit the property regularly and look for problems before they grow: humidity, leaks, the garden, the pool, the equipment. When something needs repair, we arrange it and follow the work until it is done. Before a season, we can open the house, air it, check the water, the electricity and the air conditioning, so it is ready when you or your guests arrive; after it, we close it again.

Managing your home while you live abroad

Most of our owners live outside Greece. You agree with us what we manage and how you want to be kept informed, and you deal with one contact instead of several local professionals. If you want to rent out the home, it needs an energy certificate; we arrange that too.

How we start

Talk to us about the property: where it is, what it is like and what you want from it, whether that is a rental income or simply a house that is ready when you arrive. We visit it, agree the scope and the terms with you in writing, and then take over.
